title: eGain to Announce Fiscal 2027 First Quarter Financial Results on November 5, 2026
body_markdown:
**Sunnyvale, California (October 26, 2026)** : eGain (NASDAQ:[EGAN](https://www.nasdaq.com/market-activity/stocks/egan) ), a leading provider of AI-powered knowledge management and customer experience automation solutions, will announce its fiscal 2027 first quarter financial results after the close of regular market trading on Thursday, November 5, 2026, followed by an investor conference call and webcast at 2:00 p.m. Pacific Time (5:00 p.m. ET). Chief Executive Officer Ashu Roy and Chief Financial Officer Eric Smit will host the call and webcast.


- **When** : Thursday, November 5th at 2:00 p.m. Pacific Time (5:00 p.m. ET).
- **Webcast** : A live and archived webcast of the conference call can be accessed from the investors section of eGain’s website at[www.egain.com](https://www.egain.com/) .
- **Dial In** : To access the live call, dial (800) 715-9871 (U.S. toll free) or +1 (646) 307-1963 (International) and ask to join the eGain earnings call or provide conference ID 2196366.
- **Replay** : A phone replay of the conference call will be available starting two hours after the call and remain in effect for one week. To access the phone replay, dial 855-669-9658 (U.S. toll free) or +1 412-317-0088 (International). The replay access code is 2852681.


### About eGain


eGain is a leading provider of AI-powered knowledge management and customer experience automation solutions. With over 25 years of experience in knowledge management, eGain helps enterprises unify siloed content, automate trusted knowledge workflows, and deliver measurable AI-ROI through proven frameworks and methods. Global 2000 companies across industries rely on eGain to transform customer service, improve employee productivity, reduce costs, and accelerate AI adoption. Visit[www.eGain.com](https://www.egain.com/) for more information.
